composition_summary: Preserved the supplied volatile message exactly (one user turn, unchanged). Drafted one class-22 pure-logic component pc-check-mode: it reads the raw candidate with inputs.get('mode') so absent and null are both handled without raising, accepts only the exact case-sensitive strings 'eco' or 'boost', and returns {accepted:boolean, mode:original-or-null} with no exceptions, imports, host calls or coercion. payload.name: pc-check-mode
payload.description: Pure-logic guard that validates a raw operating mode string without changing its spelling. Accepts only the exact case-sensitive strings 'eco' or 'boost'. Returns {accepted:boolean, mode:original string if accepted else null}. No exceptions, imports, host calls or type coercion; absent and null inputs are both reported as not accepted with mode=null.
